paper.title: Functional Sulfur-Doped Biocarbon for Hydrogen Storage: Development of Nanomaterials for Energy Applications

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Table 1 + text): 2 rows, 0 numeric disputes. SKPT = KOH-activated Sargassum biocarbon (pyrolysis 700 C, HCl wash to remove KOH) -> activated_carbon / chemical_activation; SSKTP = SKPT then S-doped with commercial sulfur (1:1), re-activated -> doped_carbon, dopant_element=S, dopant_concentration_wt_pct=17.45 (CHNS/XPS). BET 1670 for SKPT (Table 1 and section 3.1) is used; the abstract/conclusion state 1620 -- an internal inconsistency, noted. 318 K (45 C), 50 bar; 0.33 and 0.40 wt%. uptake_type=unspecified ('hydrogen storage capacity', no excess/absolute/total). measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts (Quantachrome Isorb-100 PCI); He void-volume calibration explicit -> calibration point earned. Agent C: extraction_method table_direct->text_direct (the uptakes are from Figure 7 / section 3.6, not a numeric table; Table 1 is textural only); S2 dopant_concentration_method=elemental_analysis. Purity point WITHHELD -- CHNS reports the sulfur dopant level, not a residual impurity in the HYC-0007 sense, consistent with the HYC-0053/0057 KOH-carbon precedent (the HCl wash is a KOH-removal workup, not purification). Both rows Tier B (8/10). An adjudication-pass B->A on a CHNS purity point was reversed as unfounded against that precedent. doped_carbon class for SSKTP (Agent B flag) upheld.
